sql:
SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000000.0, 2) AS revenue_billion
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Microsoft'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022

SELECT 
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000, 2) AS capital_expenditure_millions
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = '3M'
  AND av.metric = 'capital_expenditure'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2018

SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS total_assets
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Coca-Cola'
  AND av.metric = 'total_assets'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022

SELECT 
    c.name,
    av.fiscal_year,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS diluted_eps
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Verizon'
  AND av.metric = 'eps_diluted'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value / 1000000, 2) AS cash_and_equivalents_millions
FROM annual_values av
JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Pfizer'
  AND av.metric = 'cash_and_equivalents'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND c.name IN ('Walmart', 'Costco')
ORDER BY c.name

WITH nike_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        av.fiscal_year,
        ROUND(av.value, 2) AS revenue
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'Nike'
      AND av.metric = 'revenue'
      AND av.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    revenue
FROM nike_revenue
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.ticker,
    av.value AS net_income
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.metric = 'net_income'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2020
  AND av.value < 0
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT ROUND(AVG(av.value), 2) AS avg_net_income
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.sector = 'Information Technology'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
  AND av.metric = 'net_income'

SELECT 
    c.name AS company,
    ROUND((op.value / rev.value) * 100, 2) AS operating_margin_percent
FROM annual_values AS op
JOIN annual_values AS rev
    ON op.cik = rev.cik
   AND op.fiscal_year = rev.fiscal_year
   AND op.fiscal_year = 2023
JOIN companies AS c
    ON c.cik = op.cik
WHERE op.metric = 'operating_income'
  AND rev.metric = 'revenue'
  AND c.name = 'Microsoft'

WITH rev AS (
    SELECT av.fiscal_year,
           av.value
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'Adobe'
      AND av.metric = 'revenue'
      AND av.fiscal_year IN (2021, 2022)
)
SELECT ROUND(
           (
               MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2022 THEN value END) -
               MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN value END)
           ) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN value END) * 100,
           2
       ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM rev

WITH ops AS (
    SELECT av.cik,
           av.fiscal_year,
           av.value AS operating_cash_flow
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'General Mills'
      AND av.metric = 'operating_cash_flow'
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2020
),
cap AS (
    SELECT av.cik,
           av.fiscal_year,
           av.value AS capital_expenditure
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'General Mills'
      AND av.metric = 'capital_expenditure'
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2020
)
SELECT c.name AS company,
       ops.fiscal_year,
       ROUND((ops.operating_cash_flow - cap.capital_expenditure) / 1000000.0, 2) AS free_cash_flow_millions
FROM ops
JOIN cap ON ops.cik = cap.cik AND ops.fiscal_year = cap.fiscal_year
JOIN companies c ON ops.cik = c.cik

SELECT name
FROM companies
WHERE ticker IS NULL OR ticker = ''

WITH gp AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS gross_profit
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'gross_profit' AND fiscal_year = 2022
),
rev AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS revenue
    FROM annual_values
    WHERE metric = 'revenue' AND fiscal_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
    c.name,
    ROUND(gp.gross_profit / rev.revenue, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM gp
JOIN rev USING (cik)
JOIN companies c ON c.cik = gp.cik
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH assets AS (
    SELECT av.cik,
           av.fiscal_year,
           av.value AS assets
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'Boeing'
      AND av.metric = 'current_assets'
      AND av.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
),
liabilities AS (
    SELECT av.cik,
           av.fiscal_year,
           av.value AS liabilities
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.name = 'Boeing'
      AND av.metric = 'current_liabilities'
      AND av.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
)
SELECT a.fiscal_year,
       ROUND(a.assets / l.liabilities, 2) AS current_ratio
FROM assets a
JOIN liabilities l
  ON a.cik = l.cik
 AND a.fiscal_year = l.fiscal_year
ORDER BY a.fiscal_year

WITH company_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN av.metric = 'net_income' THEN av.value END) AS net_income,
        MAX(CASE WHEN av.metric = 'revenue'   THEN av.value END) AS revenue
    FROM companies c
    JOIN annual_values av ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE c.sector = 'Consumer Staples'
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
    GROUP BY c.name
    HAVING net_income IS NOT NULL 
       AND revenue IS NOT NULL 
       AND revenue <> 0
)
SELECT 
    name,
    ROUND(net_income / revenue, 2) AS net_profit_margin
FROM company_metrics
ORDER BY net_profit_margin DESC

WITH rev2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        av.cik,
        c.sector,
        c.name,
        av.value AS revenue
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN companies c ON av.cik = c.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'revenue'
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
    sector,
    name AS company,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM rev2022
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sector

SELECT 
    c.name,
    av.value AS revenue_first_reported,
    av.latest_value AS revenue_latest_reported
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = '3M'
  AND av.metric = 'revenue'
  AND av.fiscal_year = 2021

SELECT 
    c.name,
    av.metric,
    av.value AS original_value,
    av.latest_value,
    ROUND( (av.latest_value - av.value) / av.value * 100, 2 ) AS revision_percent
FROM annual_values AS av
JOIN companies AS c
    ON av.cik = c.cik
WHERE av.fiscal_year = 2021
  AND ABS(av.latest_value - av.value) / av.value > 0.05
ORDER BY revision_percent DESC

WITH best AS (
    SELECT cik, name
    FROM companies
    WHERE name = 'Best Buy'
),
cost_rev AS (
    SELECT av.value AS cost_rev_2023
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN best b ON av.cik = b.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'cost_of_revenue' 
      AND av.fiscal_year = 2023
),
inventory AS (
    SELECT av.fiscal_year, av.value AS inventory
    FROM annual_values av
    JOIN best b ON av.cik = b.cik
    WHERE av.metric = 'inventory' 
      AND av.fiscal_year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT 
    cr.cost_rev_2023,
    ROUND( (SUM(i.inventory) / 2.0), 2)          AS average_inventory,
    ROUND( cr.cost_rev_2023 / (SUM(i.inventory) / 2.0), 2) AS inventory_turnover
FROM cost_rev cr
CROSS JOIN inventory i
GROUP BY cr.cost_rev_2023

SELECT 
    f.accn AS accession_number,
    f.fiscal_year,
    f.period_end AS period_end_date
FROM filings f
JOIN companies c ON f.cik = c.cik
WHERE c.name = 'Foot Locker'
  AND f.form = '10-K'
  AND f.fiscal_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2022
ORDER BY f.fiscal_year
